Bidi data for the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9).

Class ranges generated from DerivedBidiClass.txt and bracket pairs from BidiBrackets.txt, both from Unicode 18.0.0: https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/ucd/extracted/DerivedBidiClass.txt https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/ucd/BidiBrackets.txt Only non-L ranges are stored; bidiClassFor returns BidiL for anything unlisted. Unassigned code points in right-to-left blocks (the @missing lines: Hebrew, Arabic, RLI blocks, currency symbols) are folded in, with explicit entries winning on overlap.

Data (c) 2026 Unicode, Inc. For terms of use and license, see https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html

Types

BidiClass = enum
  BidiL,                    ## Left to right; the default for unlisted code points.
  BidiR,                    ## Right to left (Hebrew and related scripts).
  BidiAL,                   ## Arabic letter.
  BidiEN,                   ## European number.
  BidiES,                   ## European separator.
  BidiET,                   ## European terminator.
  BidiAN,                   ## Arabic number.
  BidiCS,                   ## Common separator.
  BidiNSM,                  ## Nonspacing mark.
  BidiBN,                   ## Boundary neutral (formatting and controls).
  BidiB,                    ## Paragraph separator.
  BidiS,                    ## Segment separator (tabs and related controls).
  BidiWS,                   ## Whitespace.
  BidiON,                   ## Other neutral.
  BidiLRE,                  ## Left to right embedding.
  BidiRLE,                  ## Right to left embedding.
  BidiLRO,                  ## Left to right override.
  BidiRLO,                  ## Right to left override.
  BidiPDF,                  ## Pop directional formatting.
  BidiLRI,                  ## Left to right isolate.
  BidiRLI,                  ## Right to left isolate.
  BidiFSI,                  ## First strong isolate.
  BidiPDI                    ## Pop directional isolate.
Bidi class of one code point (UAX #9).
